title: Early Parenting Is Exhausting. Give These Gifts To Help
gist: A WIRED gift guide for new parents with little investable content. The few signals are recurring hardware-plus-subscription models (Hatch, Skylight), reviewer preference for Grownsy over the TikTok-popular Momcozy bottle washer, and a claim that modern robot vacuums have overcome their old reputation.

insights.claim: Baby and home gadgets increasingly bundle subscriptions: the $80 Hatch Baby sound machine is sold with a 3-month Hatch+ subscription, and the Skylight Calendar 2's photo-frame feature requires a paid plan.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Recurring revenue attached to consumer hardware is spreading into the parenting category.
insights.quote: Plus, it doubles as a digital photo frame, but you have to pay a subscription fee for that feature.
insights.locator: For parents who are struggling to juggle

insights.claim: The author calls the Hatch her most-used item of the past four years, which shows how sticky a product with app-controlled scenes can be when it carries over from baby to adult use (Hatch Restore).
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Hatch retains customers across life stages, a durable brand advantage in sleep tech.
insights.quote: The Hatch is my most-used item in the last four years.
insights.locator: The Hatch is my most-used item

themes.theme: Brand competition in baby and home gear

insights.claim: WIRED's testing found the Grownsy EaseClean Bottle Washer Pro ($250-290) beats the Momcozy washer that dominates TikTok buzz.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Social-media buzz and tested quality diverge, so brands that lead on TikTok can lose ground to better-tested rivals.
insights.quote: Everyone on TikTok might talk about the MomCozy washer, but the best baby bottle washer WIRED reviewer Nicole Kinning found actually comes from Grownsy.

insights.claim: The author says modern robot vacuums have shed their reputation as useless machines and now double as mops, and parents she gets hooked on them keep raving; the Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro was discounted 31% to $550.
insights.speaker: Nena Farrell
insights.so_what: Steep discounting alongside improving perception suggests robot vacuums are moving into the mainstream as prices compress.
insights.locator: I've changed the lives of multiple parents
